## Checks
- [ ] `npm test` passes (and CI is green on macOS, Linux and Windows)
- [ ] New or changed hook check: has an off switch and tests for block, allow and broken input
- [ ] New or changed skill or agent: description says when to use it; `claude plugin validate . --strict` passes
- [ ] Docs and diagrams updated (README, `docs/`), `CHANGELOG.md` has a line
- [ ] No company, person, infrastructure names, ids, emails or secrets; no AI attribution trailers in commits
